title: happy #YearInReviews season! go to show-score.com/tyler to see yours ...
transcript: okay so Broadway shows are like food, candles & men everyone has their own taste but if you wanna see what your taste in theatre looked like in 2023 Show-Score is here to help welcome to your #YearInReviews Show-Score lets you log every show you saw in New York this year and you can win a $365 gift card for doing it you wanna see my #YearInReviews so first you gotta click on all the shows you saw this year then once you're done clicking on all the shows you saw you get your #YearInReviews which tells you how many minutes you spent in the theatre how many shows you saw and how they ranked based on the reviews you left for them on Show-Score then it gives you your vibe and I love that mine was Curious Cat because she was really her play era this year now's the part where I tell you how you can win $365 from TodayTix just share this cute little graphic that Show-Score's made for you on either Facebook X or Instagram tag Show-Score tag TodayTix and you're automatically entered to win that $365 gift card happy #YearInReviews season and i'll see you at the theatre in 2024
